screens.title: 数据由你决定
screens.sub: 每个数据位都能换数据、换样式、换字体字号，或者直接隐藏。
screens.extra: 右下角趋势图可显示 15 / 30 / 60 分钟的心率、海拔、气压或身体电量。

power.title: 省电设计，放心常戴
power.sub: 表盘只做必须做的事：不开 GPS、不联网，屏幕上没显示的数据一项也不读。
power.note: 设计说明，非实测续航数据
stats: GPS、联网请求和后台定时器
只读取屏幕上正在显示的数据

同一时间只加载一个字体
power.tip: 秒数可设为「仅抬腕」或「关闭」，心率可改为每分钟刷新，进一步省电。

screens.title: Crisp to the last pixel
screens.sub: Every font is rebuilt on your watch's pixel grid, so even small text stays sharp and never smears.
screens.zoom: Time digits at 4x: clean, even strokes
screens.note: Instinct 3 simulator capture · demo data

screens.title: Six time styles
screens.sub: Switch on the watch or in the Connect IQ app.

screens.title: Dark or light. Instinct or round.

screens.note: Simulator captures · demo data

screens.title: Your data, your way
screens.sub: Change the data, style, font and size of every field, or hide it.
screens.extra: The trend chart shows 15, 30 or 60 minutes of heart rate, altitude, air pressure or Body Battery.
screens.note: Instinct 3 simulator capture · demo data

power.title: Built to sip battery
power.sub: The face only does what it must: no GPS, no network, and data you are not showing is never read.
power.note: Design notes, not measured battery life

Only the data shown on screen is read
Default power saver: trend chart / weather refresh
Font loaded in memory at a time
power.tip: Set seconds to wrist-raise only or off, and heart rate to once a minute, to save even more.

hero.headline:
复古像素，
腕上世界
hero.sub: 6 套配色 · 16 种地图 · 安装包约 60 KB

zh.note: 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

screens.title: 6 套配色，换个心情
screens.sub: 经典、琥珀、冰川、薄荷、夜光、樱花，彩色 AMOLED 和彩色 MIP 屏都能用。
screens.note: Venu 3 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

screens.title: 每种屏幕都原生绘制
screens.sub: AMOLED、彩色 MIP、黑白本能和方屏，各自按原生分辨率画，不是放大的小图。
screens.note: 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

screens.title: 复古液晶，信息满满
screens.sub: 数字时间、模拟小表盘和实时昼夜世界地图，一屏看全。
screens.extra: 9 个数据区可自定；支持的 MIP 手表可以持续走秒，AMOLED 常亮为低亮显示。
screens.note: Venu 3 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

power.title: 轻巧省电
power.sub: 安装包小，走秒只动秒数那一小块，地图缓存复用。
power.note: Venu 3 本机构建实测包体；功耗为设计说明，非实测续航
stats: Venu 3 安装包（上一版 101 KB）
持续走秒只重画秒数区域
power.tip: 超出手表的电量预算时自动降级，先停秒针、再停走秒，不会一直耗电。

hero.headline:
Retro pixels.
A living world.
hero.sub: 6 colour themes · 16 map styles · about 60 KB

screens.title: Six colour themes
screens.sub: Classic, Amber, Glacier, Mint, Night glow and Sakura, on colour AMOLED and colour MIP screens.
screens.note: Venu 3 simulator captures · demo data

screens.title: Drawn natively for every screen
screens.sub: AMOLED, colour MIP, monochrome Instinct and square screens each get native-resolution artwork.
screens.note: Simulator captures · demo data

screens.title: Retro LCD, packed with info
screens.sub: Digital time, an analogue dial and a live day-and-night world map on one screen.
screens.extra: Nine configurable data areas. Continuous seconds on supported MIP watches; dim always-on display on AMOLED.
screens.note: Venu 3 simulator capture · demo data

power.title: Light on battery and storage
power.sub: A small download, seconds that redraw only their own corner, and a cached map.
power.note: Package size from local Venu 3 build; power notes are design, not measured battery life
stats: Continuous seconds redraw only the seconds
power.tip: If the watch’s power budget is exceeded, it steps down on its own: second hand first, then seconds.

screens.title: 大字时间，数据随你

screens.title: Four mountains, one tap away
screens.sub: Summit, Ranges, Fuji and Everest. Switch on the watch or in the Connect IQ app.
screens.note: epix 2 simulator captures · demo data

screens.title: Made for every screen
screens.sub: Full-colour gradients on AMOLED, 64-colour art on colour MIP, line art on monochrome.
screens.note: Simulator captures · demo data

screens.title: Bold time, your data
screens.sub: Seven fields, each changeable or hidden, now including one left of the time on Instinct. Four panel styles.
screens.extra: System, 12- or 24-hour time with awake seconds; a dim moving always-on clock on AMOLED.
screens.note: Instinct 3 simulator capture · demo data

power.title: Under 100 KB. Pack light.
power.sub: Every watch gets a download under 100 KB, and only one mountain is loaded at a time.
power.note: Size is enforced at build time; power notes are design, not measured battery life
power.tip: Seconds run only while the watch is awake.

hero.headline:
潮起潮落，
抬腕便知
hero.sub: 30 个港口潮汐 · 12 套主题 · 3 款字体

zh.note: 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

screens.note: 模拟器截图 · 演示数据

screens.extra: 安装后按手表最近一次的位置，自动选最近的港口；也能在手机里按站名指定。图表可换成 7 天步数、距离、热量或 2 小时心率。

power.note: 潮汐为天文潮预报，仅供参考，不能用于航行
power.tip: 潮汐在手表上用调和常数离线计算，位置不上传。

hero.headline:
Tides at
a glance.
hero.sub: Tide forecasts for 30 ports · 12 themes · 3 clock styles

screens.note: Simulator captures · demo data

screens.extra: Picks the nearest port from your watch's last known location, or choose one by name in the app. The chart can also show 7 days of steps, distance or calories, or 2 hours of heart rate.

power.note: Astronomical tide predictions for reference only; not for navigation
power.tip: Tides are computed on the watch from harmonic constants: offline, and your location never leaves it.

screens.extra: 进度刻度可显示步数、爬楼、强度分钟、电量或当天进度；状态图标提示勿扰、闹钟和手机连接。Instinct 的圆窗默认显示心率。

hero.headline:
Retro LCD,
reborn.
hero.sub: Seven-segment digits · 14 colour themes · 3 digit styles

screens.note: Simulator captures · demo data

screens.extra: The progress scale shows steps, floors, intensity minutes, battery or the day; status icons flag Do Not Disturb, alarms and the phone connection. Instinct's window shows heart rate by default.

power.tip: Small seconds are off by default; when on, they run only while you look.
